description: Guardrail checkpoint for error-improvement step-04. Applying approved fixes edits live system files (SYSTEM.md, agents/*.md, skills/*, workflows/*), a high-stakes, hard-to-reverse transition. This checkpoint records a review result (pass/flag/escalate) on the run's eval record at the step transition. Naming the checkpoint here makes the eval record carry a 'systemic-fix-apply' guardrail entry.
